title: Welcome — using the plugin
intro: A quick tour of this course companion — how a course works, the buttons, and the movable toolbar.

welcome.title: Step 1 · Welcome
welcome.html:
Welcome 👋

This little panel is your course companion. It walks you through hands-on exercises and checks your work right here in your own base.

Take a minute to get familiar with it — then you'll be ready for any course. Use Next at the top to move through this tour.

how-a-course-works.title: Step 2 · How a course works
how-a-course-works.html:
How a course works

You follow each course mainly on the website. At certain points it asks you to open this plugin and pick a step — that's where you do something in your base and the plugin checks it for you.

Use the list on the left to jump between the plugin's steps. Steps are numbered to match the website (Step 2, Step 6…), so a gap in the numbers just means those steps happen on the site.

room-for-your-base.title: Step 3 · Room for your base
room-for-your-base.instruction: Drag the grip at the top center of this panel to make it taller or shorter, then press Verify at the top.
room-for-your-base.html: Some pages, like this one, are exercises: the panel shrinks to a strip at the bottom so your base stays in view while you work in it. Exercises carry a in the list on the left; the other pages open at full height. The height you choose is kept for the exercises that follow.
room-for-your-base.successMessage: Done — the exercises to come will open at that height.

the-buttons.title: Step 4 · The buttons
the-buttons.hint: This is a hint: it stays hidden until you ask for it. Press Hide hint to put it away.
the-buttons.html:
The buttons

The top bar carries everything you need for the current step:

  • Back — return to the previous step.
  • Hint — reveal a hint when you're stuck.
  • Verify (or Next) — check your work, then move on once it passes.

On the far right are the window controls: shrink to a toolbar and close.

the-movable-toolbar.title: Step 5 · The movable toolbar
the-movable-toolbar.html:
The movable toolbar

When the panel gets in the way of your base, the shrink icon (, top-right) turns it into a small toolbar you can drag anywhere. You'll try it on the next step.

While it's a toolbar the whole base stays clickable — nothing is blocked — and you keep the essentials:

  • Drag it wherever it's out of your way.
  • Info — show the instruction (and a hint) any time.
  • Verify — check your work without expanding.
  • Expand — bring the full panel back.

try-the-toolbar.title: Step 6 · Try the toolbar
try-the-toolbar.instruction: Click shrink (, top-right) to collapse this panel into the toolbar, drag it into the lower-right quarter of your screen, then press Verify on the toolbar.
try-the-toolbar.hint: Shrink with the icon at the top-right; drag using the handle on the toolbar; then click the on the toolbar. “Lower-right” means the bottom-right quarter of your whole screen.
try-the-toolbar.html:
Try the toolbar

Time to use what the last page showed: the toolbar, and its Verify.
try-the-toolbar.successMessage: Perfect — you've got the toolbar down 🎉 Expand the plugin, then press Next to finish the tour.

youre-ready.title: Step 7 · You’re ready
youre-ready.html:
You’re ready

That’s the tour. Pick a course from the list on the left to begin: each one opens on its introduction.

This tour stays in the list, so you can come back to it any time.
